author: HarryRules2002
body:
Hello, my name is Tabmow and I just wanted to get rid of some of the false (what I think are false) because they look bad on my infractions page.

Number 12419 is a warn from TheRomanTrident for rudeness. This was a week before my birthday and I said 'I'm so fucking excited for my Birthday.' This was not directed at anybody nor was it spammed.

Number 125090 is a warn from DoctaPop for please be less vulgar in chat. I simply said 'Fucking Hell' in anger because I fell into the void.

Number 125332 is a temp-ban from Zeusy for Combat logging. What happened was I wasn't allowed to play the computer but I was, mum came in so I quickly disconnected as I was about to fight Zeusy. (I can understand why you deny this if you do)

Number 127117 is a kick from Emmaye for Profanity. I messaged him saying 'ez kid rekt' and he kicked me. He doesn't have anything to prove that I did aswell.

Number 605294 is a kick from Emmaye for building inappropriate structures. A whole lot of people were defending on Ternio and everyone was placing signs and I built a structure by accident that looked like a penis, Emmaye proceeded to kick me.

Number 622014 is a warn from Archived for harassment in /msg. Rilo kept messaging me with spam, I ignored it but then he kept on doing it and I told him to stop and he kept doing it so I said 'fuck off kid' and he told staff.

Number 624741 is a warn from Posighdun for Publicly accusing people of hacking. Tynvale had the same skin as me and I said 'Tynvale hacks, he has the same skin as me!'

Thankyou :)
